findingDetails.title: The advisor contract-key module names two consumers that do not exist, so its stated single-source guarantee covers only the descriptor
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg over .skilled for the two tuples, ALLOWED_PARAMETERS and tool-input-schemas returns only the two descriptors, the two type aliases and the header; ls runtime/schemas confirms the named file is absent; both files are in config.reviewScopeFiles.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A consumer of ALLOWED_PARAMETERS or schemas/tool-input-schemas.ts exists outside the reviewed tree and imports the tuples, restoring the header's claim; or the header is rewritten to name only the descriptor consumers and the Zod link is added.
findingDetails.case: A maintainer adds options.reasoningEffort to ADVISOR_RECOMMEND_PARAMETER_KEYS: the descriptor type forces the descriptor property and the CLI manifest copy is caught by the parity suite, but AdvisorRecommendInputSchema at schemas/advisor-tool-schemas.ts:259 stays unchanged because no import links it to the tuple, so the handler's parse at handlers/advisor-recommend.ts:641 rejects a parameter the CLI advertises.

findingDetails.title: The feature-catalog CLI entry cites its parity suite at a path that does not exist
findingDetails.scopeProof: An existence probe over 230 code/doc paths cited by the feature catalog resolves 229; the only miss is tests/skill-advisor-cli-manifest-parity.vitest.ts. The same catalog file's Validation and Tests table uses the correct runtime/tests/ base at :31-39, which fixes the intended base.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A root-level tests/ directory or build step materializes tests/skill-advisor-cli-manifest-parity.vitest.ts; the citation then resolves and the finding is a base-path clarity nit.
findingDetails.case: An operator follows the overview path to confirm manifest drift fails CI; the open fails and the guarantee reads as unenforced although runtime/tests/skill-advisor-cli-manifest-parity.vitest.ts:15-30 enforces it.

results.summary: The reference's fail-closed trusted-caller guarantee is inverted by advisor-server.ts:236-258 plus the shipped launcher default; the CLI half of the gate is honest and structurally enforced (skill-advisor-cli.ts:747-761, sole call site :779). Carried as R2-P1-001.
Packet 016 carries no checklist.md or acceptance-criteria.md and its spec.md heading walk contains no acceptance or checklist section, so there are no rows whose evidence could be checked.

The manifest parity guarantee holds (9/9 identical on the dist probe, source suite at :15-30) and 229/230 catalog paths resolve, but the CLI overview cites a nonexistent root-level test path (R3-P2-002) and the fail-closed headline contradicts the launcher default (R2-P1-001).

noveltyJustification: Two new P2 contracts-drift findings (weight 2) plus one 0.5x refinement of carried R2-P1-001 (weight 2.5) over a weighted total of 14 (one P1 at 5, nine P2 at 9): 4.5/14 = 0.321. The ratio is above the 0.10 threshold, so the run is not converged; novelty is real rather than restated, because both findings come from cross-registry probes that had not run before (tuple consumers, catalog path existence) and the P1 refinement adds measured socket reachability.
